Key.merchantPre: This is {{player}}'s {{item}}. Where does it lead? Why don't you buy it for {{count}} candies and find out?
Key.sorceressPre: {{player}} needs this {{item}} to open the path to their final encounter. I can let them have it for {{count}} lollipops.

Sword.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test. This {{item}} is strong enough to cut through any living thing in the world of {{game}}, and I feel that {{player}} is ready to wield it. Good luck!

Shield.forgePost: This {{item}} can protect {{player}} from just about anything; even a dragon! I even got help from the dragon to check.

Health Upgrade.sorceressPre: Candies are good for your health, but only in our world. This, however, is good for {{player}}'s health. They can have it for {{count}} lollipop.

Confetti Cannon.merchantPre: This deluxe {{item}} is perfect for celebrating any occasion, even if that occasion is nothing at all! Only {{count}} candies to send one to {{player}}!

Confetti Cannon.cyclops: Congratulations! You passed the test. Why not celebrate with a {{item}}? Here's one for {{player}}.

Math Trap.merchantPre: Everyone loves math, right? For the low price of {{count}} candies, you can send {{player}} a surprise that will test their math skills.
Math Trap.sorceressPre: For {{count}} lollipops, I can challenge {{player}} on their math skills.

Math Trap.sorceressPost: I never really liked math myself. I like spelling better. It's more magical.
